name: com.sammapix/sammapix
title: SammaPix — Image & PDF tools for AI agents
description: Agent-native image & PDF processing with 20+ tools: compress, convert, resize, crop, rotate, flip, adjust, grayscale, blur, tint, negate, border, round, watermark, read metadata; compress/merge/split/rotate PDFs, images-to-PDF, PDF info; and chain any image operations in one call (pipeline).
